text: In the Australian outback, a giant razorback boar smashes through Jake Cullen's house and carries off his grandson, and the old man [stands trial for the boy's murder|wrong|innocents wrongly punished] because [no one believes his story|rules|no one believes you]. Two years later, American reporter Beth Winters [films wildlife being hunted for pet food|wrong|harming the natural world] and disappears. Her husband Carl comes looking, and is [chased through the night by a herd of wild pigs|threat|nature turning on us] while two brutal brothers at the cannery hide what they know.
